The 'Taraia Object' was first seen in 2020 satellite imagery and in 1938 aerial photos. Purdue/ALI announced on Oct 19 (local time) it was likely a collection of large trees; only a Y-shaped segment remained.
The shine was a carbonate veneer of coral sand, not metal. A ~30-inch steel tube found in the lagoon is being studied; Purdue does not link it to the Electra. Sources: Purdue, NBC News, USA Today.
